races.paceDynamic: Star Artist will take this race along from the front with his prominent style, setting what should be a comfortable tempo given the lack of other early pace. Prizeland and Keep It Cool will track from hold-up positions while La Tosca's undefined style adds uncertainty to the tactical picture. With only one genuine pace-setter in a small field over 1m4f, this sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses who can track the moderate gallop and produce their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Star Artist sets a steady pace without pressure from the field
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Prizeland and Keep It Cool allow them to conserve energy before unleashing late runs. Star Artist's moderate tempo plays directly into their hands as they can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Star Artist gets away with a very soft lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage while the hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground. His experience at this distance pays dividends when he finds extra in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Tempo Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and all horses remain in contention
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f marker with class and form taking precedence over tactics. Prizeland's superior rating and recent win give him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: La Tosca Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If La Tosca adopts aggressive front-running tactics to pressure Star Artist
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced filly's unknown style creates a faster pace that exposes the stamina limitations of her rivals. Her light weight and potential improvement factor into an upset victory.

races.paceDynamic: Okiru and Grand Echo will contest the early lead, with Okiru likely to set a stronger gallop given Luke Morris's positive ride and the horse's more consistent front-running form. Mighty Vega, Sand Lily, Victory Ace and Based will sit prominent behind the leaders, while the hold-up brigade of Starlight Sami, Roccobear, Legacy Rock and Militzie will need the pace to collapse. With two genuine pace-setters ensuring an honest tempo over 7f, this race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical pace who can track the leaders without getting embroiled in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Okiru and Grand Echo engage in a sustained pace battle through the first 5f
scenarios.body: The early leaders will soften each other up, allowing the prominent runners to pounce in the final 2f with fresher legs. Mighty Vega and Victory Ace are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their proven ability to sit handy and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Okiru can steal a march on Grand Echo and dictate comfortable fractions
scenarios.body: Luke Morris can employ Watson's tactical awareness to control the tempo and kick clear when the prominent horses make their move. Okiru's consistent 7f form at Lingfield gives him the edge in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong and the prominent runners get drawn into the battle
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses will benefit from a truly-run race that sets up perfectly for their closing kicks. Starlight Sami and Roccobear have the class to unleash finishing bursts if the pace collapses dramatically.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Okiru and Grand Echo show early speed but neither wants the lead
scenarios.body: A messy, stop-start affair will develop where tactical pace becomes crucial and positioning trumps pure speed. Based and Sand Lily could capitalize on a scrappy finish where experience matters most.

races.paceDynamic: Lordsbridge Bay is the only confirmed front runner in this 12-runner field, meaning he can dictate terms from the front without early pressure. The prominent runner will face minimal challenge in the opening stages, likely creating a steady but sustainable gallop that won't burn off his stamina reserves. Behind him, a wall of hold-up horses including Denby's Dream, Sail On Sailor, and Mohaab will be looking for gaps in what could become a congested finish. This pace setup heavily favours front runners and prominent racers who can position early and avoid the traffic problems that will plague the large contingent of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lordsbridge Bay gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The prominent racer controls the tempo throughout and has enough left to resist late challenges, with the patient hold-up horses failing to make up the ground in time. This validates the pace advantage of being handy early in a race lacking genuine speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong despite the lack of early speed and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop plays into the hands of the strongest finishers who can quicken best in the final furlong when others tire. Hold-up horses like Sail On Sailor and Mohaab benefit from their fresh finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of hold-up horses creates a wall of horses turning for home with limited room
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get blocked or forced wide, allowing a horse with a clear run to capitalize on others' misfortune. The winner emerges more through positioning luck than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites all encounter problems and fail to fire on the same day
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner gets ideal conditions and trip to spring a surprise at rewarding odds. This scenario relies on multiple market leaders underperforming simultaneously.

races.paceDynamic: Epictetus will lead from the gates but faces immediate pressure from five prominent runners (Bravo Zulu, Arctician, Mr Baloo, Criminal, Warning Sign) all wanting the same early positioning. This congestion will create a messy first two furlongs before settling into sustained tempo with Epictetus likely getting his own way in front. The real danger comes at the business end when the prominent pack bunches up turning for home, creating traffic problems 2-3 furlongs out. This pace shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can stay wide and sweep around the inevitable trouble.

scenarios.body: The five prominent runners will create a wall of horses that struggle to find racing room while Helm Rock, Panama Black, and Big Sip get clear runs from the back. Epictetus's honest gallop sets it up perfectly for closers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent pack finds a seam through the traffic
scenarios.body: The early pace pressure doesn't materialize fully and one from the Bravo Zulu/Arctician/Mr Baloo group gets first run on Epictetus. Form and class tells with the survivors from the prominent positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Epictetus Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the leader gets too soft a time in front early
scenarios.body: Without enough pressure from the prominent pack, Epictetus conserves energy and proves tough to peg back despite the closers' late charge. His honest front-running style pays dividends on this sharp track.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and becomes a sprint from the home turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash where tactical speed matters more than sustained finishing kick. The prominent runners with natural pace have the edge in a sprint finish.

races.paceDynamic: Bergamo Gold will take this field along as the sole front runner, with Pangbourne likely tracking in second and the remaining five horses settling further back. With only one confirmed pace-setter, Bergamo Gold can dictate comfortable splits without pressure, potentially stealing a march on the hold-up brigade. The lack of early pace pressure creates a tactical race where the leader gets first run, but there's enough quality among the closers to mount challenges. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and the pace-setter, as the soft early fractions will make it difficult for hold-up horses to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.body: The front runner's effort tells in the final furlong, allowing Pangbourne to take over smoothly from his tracking position. Heart Sign and Chhota Saab benefit from the late collapse but can't quite reach the new leader.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where fitness and recent form matter more than class, allowing a horse like Gifts Differing to capitalize on the chaos. Chhota Saab's consistent placing record makes him dangerous in a messy finish.
